changes: Independent W21 source copy with simulation-only bank exports; arithmetic, streams, parameter signature and quantization stay identical. Testbench wraps the existing validator.
conclusion: Only an exact bank and butterfly match allows W24 C synthesis.

estimates.basis: Frozen W21 reports. C-only probe changes no synthesized arithmetic; export 9216 transformed Conv1 coefficients, 2048 Conv2 coefficients, 800 Conv3 coefficients and 97 biases after the ordinary runtime load. Compare all 12161 signed integer carriers with separately generated AP_RND_CONV/AP_SAT/G2 ROM content.

interpretation: Require equality for each layer coefficient and bias, including ordering, saturation and convergent rounding. This C-only export is not a hardware resource measurement.
name: runtime_rom_bank_equivalence
purpose: WS-B equivalence prerequisite: export the exact post-load private banks from a frozen W21 copy during two butterfly C calls, compare every stored integer against generated constant ROM contents and retain the ordinary exact output/border checks. No synthesis is permitted for the ROM candidate before this prerequisite passes.
